title: Shared responsibility on BTP
explain: SAP secures platform layers; you secure apps, identities, data, configs, and tenants. (Tier 1–2 simulation fidelity — verify production details in official SAP docs.)
analogy: Think of "Shared responsibility on BTP" as a named building block you must explain under pressure.
whyItMatters: Without Shared responsibility on BTP, you mis-diagnose incidents and make weak architecture choices.
commonMistakes: Memorizing the name of Shared responsibility on BTP without a failure story
howToApply: Use Shared responsibility on BTP explicitly in a design defense sentence
mnemonic: NAME IT TO TAME IT: Say “Shared responsibility on BTP” + one failure mode out loud — if you can't, you don't own it yet. (Shared → mechanism → failure)
useCases: Greenfield design workshop: decide if “Shared responsibility on BTP” is required given constraints (latency, clean-core, team skills).
Incident bridge: symptoms appear; use “Shared responsibility on BTP” to classify the failing hop before changing config.
Architecture review board: defend why you accepted residual risk around “Shared responsibility on BTP”.
